_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Paul Selver (1888-1970): Karel Čapek's R.U.R. (1923) and, with Josef Čapek, The Insect Play ('And So Ad Infinitum', 1923), both adapted with Nigel Playfair. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 31); Adam may veto. No uids minted. Round 112 (2026-10-17, vetoable) added his Bohemian (1912), Russian (1917), Slavonic (1919) and Czech (1920) anthologies, Machar's The Jail (1921), Karel Čapek's Letters from England (1925) and Josef Čapek's The Land of Many Names (1926), from archive.org scans.

_pending.anthology-of-czechoslovak-literature: Selver's An Anthology of Czechoslovak Literature (Kegan Paul; catalogued 1929), Digital Library of India scan in.ernet.dli.2015.178489: no year is printed on its title page or preface and the latest date in it is a 1928 death, so a later impression cannot be ruled out. _excluded.otakar-brezina-study: Selver's Otakar Březina: A Study in Czech Literature (Blackwell, 1921) is a critical study, not a translation.

_name_words_note: Translator name only: fetch_shelf.py treats it as the identity check, so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.

sel-capek-letters-from-england.post_1930_examined: Examined in round 112: 1938 is Čapek's death year in a library catalogue label ('Capek, Karel, 1890-1938'); the imprint reads Geoffrey Bles, first published March 1925, reprinted to June 1925.

sel-josef-capek-land-of-many-names.post_1930_examined: Examined in round 112: 2014 is the Internet Archive's digitising line; the imprint reads George Allen & Unwin, first published 1926.

_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
